title: Development and Internal Validation of Machine Learning-Based Risk Prediction Models for Depression in Older Adults Undergoing Maintenance Hemodialysis.
summary: Internal ML risk models for depressive symptoms among 226 older maintenance-hemodialysis patients showed similar AUCs (0.851–0.865); naive Bayes was best calibrated/discriminative. Single-center internal validation only. Publication venue was not available in the checked primary metadata. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
